items.title: Richard Brunies Interview, 1959-04-27
items.q: So it was Grover, his wife, his brother-in-law, and Ricky Tomes, and myself, and August Shillain.

ctx.x: So it was Grover, his wife, his brother-in-law, and Ricky Tomes, and myself, and August Shillain. He's there, three, three, three, not so long ago. And we used to play at Anderson. Some Anderson. And they did away with Armstrong. Armstrong went up north and did good. Yeah. And I stayed down there and did bad.
Oh, well, maybe you had a good time, too, here.
